title: acre draws libsufr's key schemes, masked and unmasked, with the code's structure
body: libsufr's `build.rs` now splits key making into `Packing` and a `KeyScheme` trait with two implementations, `UnmaskedKeys` and `MaskedKeys`. `crates/acre/examples/prefix-encoder.acre` uses the old name `PrefixEncoder` and shows only the unmasked keys. The new figure, `examples/key-schemes.acre`, replaces it. It shows how the types fit together, `Packing` once, both schemes on one text with a 24-character spaced seed mask, and how each orders ties and takes an LCP. Every field of `Packing`, `UnmaskedKeys` and `MaskedKeys` appears.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/cd2d1020
notes.text: examples/key-schemes.acre is written and renders. tmp-claude/2026-11-13-key-schemes/model.py checked every key, the masked key 0x6522ca65384c0000, care_bits, window_offset [6, 0] and pad_bits 16. prefix-encoder.acre is removed, and the formatter's idempotence test now reads key-schemes.acre. Not committed yet.
